mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.cover_image, s.created_at, s.updated_at, COUNT(p.id) as post_count FROM post_series s LEFT JOIN posts p ON s.id = p.series_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'published' WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.description, s.cover_image, s.created_at, s.updated_at ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.cover_image, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, u.username as creator_username, COUNT(p.id) as post_count FROM post_series s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.created_by = u.id LEFT JOIN posts p ON s.id = p.series_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
s.deleted_at IS NULL
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.description, s.cover_image, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at, u.username ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.cover_image, s.created_at, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.series_id = s.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'published') as post_count FROM post_series s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post_series SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
